run_command: docker compose up -d (docker-compose.yml + .env from example.env, UPLOAD_LOCATION required); services: immich-server, immich-machine-learning, redis/valkey, Postgres w/ pgvector. Source dev: `cp docker/example.env docker/.env && pnpm i && mise dev` (docker-compose.dev.yml).
host: Prod/compose: server+API+web on http://localhost:2283, API base path /api (http://localhost:2283/api). Local dev: web dev server http://localhost:3000 (Vite, proxies to server), API on http://localhost:2283/api.
api_style: REST + OpenAPI (NestJS + @nestjs/swagger). Base path /api (setGlobalPrefix('api')). Swagger UI at /doc, spec at /api/spec.json + /api/spec.yaml; checked-in spec open-api/immich-openapi-specs.json drives SDK generation.
spa: yes — SvelteKit (Svelte 5) with adapter-static, fallback:index.html, ssr=false (fully client-rendered SPA); built assets served by the NestJS server.
auth: required for nearly all endpoints (@Authenticated()/AuthGuard, excludes login/admin-sign-up). Three credential shapes: (1) Bearer JWT in Authorization, (2) session cookie immich_access_token (set by POST /api/auth/login), (3) API key via x-api-key header.
